objective.en: Solve picture word problems by acting them out and drawing them.
objective.id: Menyelesaikan soal cerita bergambar dengan memeragakan dan menggambarnya.

materials.en: Paper, crayons and up to 10 large counters
materials.id: Kertas, krayon, dan sampai 10 keping besar

preparation.en: Think of two short stories from your child's life (one adding, one taking away).
preparation.id: Siapkan dua cerita pendek dari kehidupan anak (satu menambah, satu mengambil).

steps.en: Tell the first story: 'You have 4 crayons. Grandma gives you 3 more. How many now?'
steps.id: Ceritakan yang pertama: 'Kamu punya 4 krayon. Nenek memberi 3 lagi. Sekarang berapa?'

steps.en: Your child acts it out with counters, then draws circles for the story.
steps.id: Anak memeragakan dengan keping, lalu menggambar lingkaran untuk ceritanya.

steps.en: Ask them to explain the drawing. Then do a taking-away story.
steps.id: Minta anak menjelaskan gambarnya. Lalu lakukan cerita mengambil.

adultWording.en: Show me the story with counters.
How does your drawing show it?

cleanup.en: Put the counters away and keep the drawing.

variations.en: Your child tells you a story to draw.
variations.id: Anak menceritakan kisah untuk Anda gambar.

safetyNotes.en: An adult stays within reach for the whole activity.
safetyNotes.id: Orang dewasa tetap dalam jangkauan selama kegiatan.

safetyNotes.en: Stop whenever your child loses interest. Try again another day.
safetyNotes.id: Berhenti kapan pun anak kehilangan minat. Coba lagi di hari lain.

safetyNotes.en: Use only objects bigger than your child's fist.
safetyNotes.id: Gunakan hanya benda yang lebih besar dari kepalan tangan anak.

parentNotes.en: This is the concrete and pictorial stage that leads to the bar models in Grade 1.
parentNotes.id: Ini tahap konkret dan gambar yang mengarah ke model batang di Kelas 1.
